item.title: Israel and Iran exchange strikes as Trump says U.S. is negotiating end to war
item.summary: Israel and four Gulf states reported Iranian attacks a day after President Trump said talks to end the war were underway. Iran denies direct negotiations are taking place.

item.title: Trump says U.S. is postponing some strikes as it negotiates end to war with Iran
item.summary: The president’s announcement sent markets up and energy prices diving, as investors bet Iran’s blockade of a key shipping chokepoint could soon end.

item.title: At least one winner emerges from Iran war: U.S. natural gas exporters
item.summary: Stock markets fell sharply in Asia and Europe on Monday amid deepening anxiety over the ongoing war and the prospect of further disruptions to global energy markets.

item.title: Trump threats, U.S. troop build-up raise specter of battle for Hormuz
item.summary: Israelis said securing the strait for energy shipments could become the war’s main goal now that regime change and ending Iran’s ability to obtain a nuclear weapon seem out of reach.

item.title: Joe Kent says he wants Trump to hear MAGA opposition to Iran war
item.summary: In an interview with The Post after resigning from the administration in protest, the veteran said he is taking his message to the president’s supporters.

item.title: Trump says peace talks progressing as Iran officials deny negotiations
item.summary: Egypt, Pakistan and Turkey have taken the lead in efforts to broker a peace deal between the United States and Iran, though conversations have been indirect thus far.

item.title: Rare Middle East storm could bring floods, damaging winds and tornadoes
item.summary: Parts of the Arabian Peninsula and Persian Gulf could be hit by strong thunderstorms later this week. Major highways and airports in the region could be inundated.

item.title: Ambulances set ablaze at London synagogue in attack Starmer calls antisemitic
item.summary: No one was hurt in the blaze, which damaged four ambulances operated by a Jewish charity in north London’s Golders Green neighborhood, officials said.

item.title: Rubio to testify against friend accused of secretly working for Maduro
item.summary: Former congressman David Rivera, accused of secretly lobbying for Nicolás Maduro’s government in Venezuela, climbed Miami politics alongside Marco Rubio.
